bin/java.text:
#!/bin/sh
# a stand-in Java: answers the version probe as Java 25, runs "BuildTools" and the NeoForge installer
case "$1" in
  -XshowSettings:properties|-version)
    echo 'openjdk version "25.0.1" <date>' >&2
    echo '    os.arch = amd64' >&2
    exit 0 ;;
esac
if [ "$1" = "-jar" ]; then
  jar=$2; shift 2
  case "$jar" in
    BuildTools.jar)
      while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
        case "$1" in --rev) rev=$2; shift ;; --output-dir) out=$2; shift ;; --final-name) fn=$2; shift ;; esac
        shift
      done
      echo "Loading BuildTools version: stand-in"
      echo "   Attempting to build version: '$rev'   "
      echo ""
      echo "Attempting to build version: '$rev'"
      if [ "$rev" = "9.9" ]; then echo "Could not get version $rev"; echo "it does not exist"; exit 3; fi
      head -c 4096 /dev/zero > "$out/$fn"
      echo "Success! Everything completed successfully."
      exit 0 ;;
    *installer.jar)
      dir=$2
      echo "installing into the server folder"
      echo "fake log" > "$dir/$(basename "$jar").log"
      case "$jar" in
        *26.3.0.9*) echo "Downloading libraries"; echo "ERROR: a library failed its checksum"; exit 1 ;;
      esac
      head -c 2048 /dev/zero > "$dir/server.jar"
      mkdir -p "$dir/libraries/net/neoforged"
      echo "The server installed successfully"
      exit 0 ;;
  esac
fi
echo "stand-in java: unexpected $*" >&2
exit 9

jre/java.text:
#!/bin/sh
# a stand-in Java: answers the version probe as Java 25, runs "BuildTools" and the NeoForge installer
case "$1" in
  -XshowSettings:properties|-version)
    echo 'openjdk version "25.0.1" <date>' >&2
    echo '    os.arch = amd64' >&2
    exit 0 ;;
esac
if [ "$1" = "-jar" ]; then
  jar=$2; shift 2
  case "$jar" in
    BuildTools.jar)
      while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
        case "$1" in --rev) rev=$2; shift ;; --output-dir) out=$2; shift ;; --final-name) fn=$2; shift ;; esac
        shift
      done
      echo "Loading BuildTools version: stand-in"
      echo "   Attempting to build version: '$rev'   "
      echo ""
      echo "Attempting to build version: '$rev'"
      if [ "$rev" = "9.9" ]; then echo "Could not get version $rev"; echo "it does not exist"; exit 3; fi
      head -c 4096 /dev/zero > "$out/$fn"
      echo "Success! Everything completed successfully."
      exit 0 ;;
    *installer.jar)
      dir=$2
      echo "installing into the server folder"
      echo "fake log" > "$dir/$(basename "$jar").log"
      case "$jar" in
        *26.3.0.9*) echo "Downloading libraries"; echo "ERROR: a library failed its checksum"; exit 1 ;;
      esac
      head -c 2048 /dev/zero > "$dir/server.jar"
      mkdir -p "$dir/libraries/net/neoforged"
      echo "The server installed successfully"
      exit 0 ;;
  esac
fi
echo "stand-in java: unexpected $*" >&2
exit 9
